integrity: The coefficient and uniqueness are supported by exact edge-integral identities, an explicit derivative sign proof with a uniform Taylor remainder, and executable symbolic/numerical cross-checks. Root decimals are approximations.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-ratio, single-vertex, epsilon-to-zero first-order theorem only; no global finite-size optimum, uniform ratio-varying bound, or independent priority certification.
title: Sharp fixed-area first-order width regularization by an asymmetric triangular corner cut
